title: FAA UAP reports, batch 16 (237UAP00389 - 237UAP00454)
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA reports regarding UAP sightings by commercial and private pilots between 2019 and 2023.

incidents.summary: Alaska 428 reported a slow moving UFO with a flashing white light.
incidents.quote: REPORTED A SLOW MOVING UFO WITH A FLASHING WHITE LIGHT

incidents.summary: Endeavor 3468 observed a large UAS or UFO at 11,300 feet.
incidents.quote: OBSERVED A LARGE UAS OR UFO AT 11,300 FEET

incidents.summary: N39RC reported a white UFO circling at FL450.
incidents.quote: REPORTED A WHITE UFO FROM THE RIGHT SIDE CIRCLING AT FL450

incidents.summary: UPS 913 reported a fast moving white torpedo shaped object.
incidents.quote: PILOT STATED WHITE TORPEDO SHAPED OBJECT

incidents.summary: N499PA observed a UFO with a line of stationary strobe lights.
incidents.quote: UFO WITH A LINE OF STATIONARY STROBE LIGHTS ABOVE

incidents.summary: Flexjet 359 reported a UFO sighting 10,000 feet above aircraft, causing autopilot issues.
incidents.quote: REPORTED UFO SIGHTING 10,000 FEET ABOVE ACFT

incidents.summary: Allegiant 913 reported lights with no contrail at high altitude.
incidents.quote: THE UNKNOWN PHENOMENON WAS DESCRIBED AS LIGHTS WITH NO CONTRAIL

incidents.summary: American 2561 reported a possible UFO sighting above their altitude.
incidents.quote: REPORTED A POSSIBLE UFO SIGHTING ABOVE HIS ALTITUDE

incidents.quote: REPORTED UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENA-UFO FROM THE 12 O'CLOCK POSITION

incidents.quote: REPORTED AN AERIAL PHENOMENON-UFO FROM THE 12 O'CLOCK POSITION

incidents.quote: UAP APPEARED TO BE TWO ACFT WITH RED AND WHITE LIGHTS

incidents.quote: REPORTED AN UNIDENTIFIED AERIAL PHENOMENON OF RED/GREEN/WHITE LIGHTS
